description: The Joint Allocation Office (JAO) runs auctions of cross-border transmission capacity rights on behalf of European transmission system operators and publishes the related market data. The home page, read on 2026-09-26, states that it serves 50 transmission operators and more than 500 registered market participants, holds more than 26,000 auctions a year for yearly, seasonal, quarterly, monthly, weekly, daily and intraday products, and also provides clearing, settlement and reporting. Public sections include market data and auction results, an auction calendar, a message board of capacity curtailment notices (several were posted that day for Italian borders, each naming the operator, border, hours, curtailed megawatts and the security limit), the Core flow-based day-ahead and intraday publication tool with its static grid model, KPI reports, and pages for interconnectors such as Nemo Link, IFA and Viking Link; an API is listed under support. Coverage is European bidding-zone borders. No licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: bidding and nomination require registration, and flow-based files need domain knowledge. Simulation uses are cross-border capacity constraints for market coupling and zonal models, and curtailment event histories. Related records: data-core-tso-substations-osm-georeferencing maps the Core static grid model elements.
